_fractional_points_note: Yahoo settings page confirms fractional points are ON for this league, so yardage-based scoring (e.g. '25 yards per point') must be implemented as a continuous multiply (yards * points_per_unit), NOT floor(yards / threshold). Some platforms/leagues do integer-floor yardage bonuses instead -- this one explicitly does not.
